title: Amendment 3 settlement of its first spec review: keep the old test name as a group, assert every macOS detail field, record the plugin's platform resolution
context: The first spec review of amendment 3 (windows-reminder-guard 16.34) found three issues. First, the Step deleted the test 'on macOS and Android the scheduler cancels then schedules as before', which the frozen run items (items.json:808) still gate at ship through accept.zsh's --plain-name, so the ship would stop. Second, the rows checked only that macOS details exist, while the criterion promised today's details. Third, the claim that the plugin resolves only the platform's own implementation had no ran fact.
options: Wrap the three new tests in a group named exactly the old test name; state 16.34 as exactly the asserted values (Android channel id, name and description, high importance and priority; all 14 macOS detail fields null); add outside facts f-plugin-resolve, f-darwin-defaults and f-gate-old-name
Keep the old test as well as the three new ones
Reword 16.34 to say only that macOS details are present
Refresh the frozen items.json so the ship gate uses the new names
option_reasons: U+002D-plain-name matches by substring, so the group keeps the landed build's gate working with no change to the run. Asserting every field closes the gap the round-1 blocker belongs to as a whole, for macOS and Android details alike.
It would keep a test that cannot fail on a changed reminder, the very defect being fixed.
That weakens an Unchanged promise to fit the test, and leaves the macOS sound and interruption settings unguarded.
The pipeline rule freezes items.json after the first build so every resume and the ship plan from the same items.
outcome: Applied the first option to the record and to spec section 17. check_record --complete, both renders, check_spec and both check_items pass. A follow-up spec review is running with the three issues and review-diff.txt.
